stem.text: Water is pumped through a nozzle at the end of a hose. The nozzle has a circular cross-section of diameter $50\,\text{mm}$. A mass of $100\,\text{kg}$ of water takes a time of $2.0\,\text{s}$ to move through the nozzle. The density of water is $1000\,\text{kg m}^{-3}$.
What is the speed of the water in the nozzle?
